correctness.rationale: Under binary utility a mutually improving swap requires both agents initially segregated, of opposite type, hence equilibrium iff no segregated vertices of both colors. In a cycle this is exactly one color with no run length≥3. Each minority blue contributes at most two integrated majority reds: upper bound min(n,3b), attained by constructed runs; composition lower bound b+ceil(b/2)+1 attained by one long red run. Marked run-start compositions and inclusion-exclusion give E_b,r(z). Direct swap-test enumeration for all 3≤n≤11 and every minority b agrees coefficientwise and on extrema.
